fieldValues.title: A group's input queue is its wg label plus intake
fieldValues.decision_question: How is a group's input queue modelled?
fieldValues.context: D6 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We model a group's input queue as its `wg:` label plus `intake`, because labels are the execution surface every routine already reads.
fieldValues.rationale: Labels are the execution surface every routine already reads.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Intake exceeds about ten items a week.
